parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of stainless steel, designed to be pressed by hand to release liquid soap.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the actuator that compresses the internal pump mechanism to dispense soap through the outlet.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is the spout-like part of the dispenser, made of stainless steel, through which the liquid soap exits.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of soap from the internal pump to the user's hand, ensuring controlled dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the pressing lid and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of durable plastic, designed to hold the liquid soap.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the soap and supports the pump mechanism, providing stability to the entire dispenser.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and serves as the structural foundation of the dispenser.
